name: Sales Order-custom_shopify_cancellation_hold
label: Shopify Cancellation Hold
description: Persistent hard hold set from a verified Shopify cancellation. Blocks D2C release, packing and dispatch until the cancellation case is resolved.

name: Delivery Note-custom_shopify_cancellation_hold
label: Shopify Cancellation Hold
description: Persistent hard hold inherited from the Shopify Sales Order cancellation. Blocks packing and dispatch.

name: Sales Order-custom_shopify_address_change_hold
label: Shopify Address Change Hold
description: Hard hold when Shopify changed the delivery address after Atlas release. Blocks automatic release, packing and dispatch until CS/Ops resolve the case.

name: Delivery Note-custom_shopify_address_change_hold
label: Shopify Address Change Hold
description: Hard hold inherited from a Shopify address change after a Delivery Note existed. Blocks packing and dispatch.

name: Item-custom_boxes_per_unit
label: Boxes per Unit
description: Physical boxes one unit of this SKU ships in, for D2C AWB planning. 0 = nestable accessory (packs inside a parent appliance's box), 1 = own box (default), 2+ = multi-box combo shipped in that many parcels (e.g. airfryer + slow juicer = 2). Order AWBs = sum of this over all lines x qty (floored at 1).

name: Delivery Note-custom_d2c_defer_si
label: Defer Sales Invoice (D2C automation)
description: Set to 1 by the D2C release automation. While 1, the 'Auto Create SI on Shopify DN Submit' script SKIPS this DN so no invoice is raised at submit (the DN exists only to produce the AWB + label for packing). The SHPSI27 invoice is created later, after physical dispatch, via the evening D2C Invoice Run (invoice-after-dispatch). Manual sheet-flow DNs leave this 0 and invoice at submit as before.

name: Delivery Note-custom_shopify_fulfilled
label: Shopify Fulfilled
description: Set by the D2C label-fetch job once the Shopify fulfillment + tracking is pushed. Prevents re-pushing.

name: Delivery Note-custom_box_count
label: D2C Box Count
description: Expected physical boxes for this D2C order (from the box model). The AWB guard blocks label/invoice/dispatch if fewer AWBs are minted.

name: Delivery Note-custom_awb_shortfall
label: AWB Shortfall (held)
description: Set when the courier minted fewer AWBs than D2C Box Count — the DN is HELD (not labelled/invoiced/dispatched) until fixed.

name: Delivery Note-custom_parcel_plan
label: Parcel Plan (D2C multibox)
description: JSON parcel plan written by the D2C release job for 2-parcel multibox orders; the ClickPost script executes it (one AWB per parcel, value-weighted COD).

name: Delivery Note-custom_awb_list
label: AWB List (all parcels JSON)
description: JSON [{awb,courier}] for ALL parcels of an N-box order (Phase 2b). awb_number+custom_awb_2 keep parcels 1-2 for backward compat; the guard/label-fetch/fulfillment read this for the full set.

name: Delivery Note-custom_dispatched
label: Dispatched (scanned)
description: Set by the D2C dispatch-scan flow when all of the order's parcels have been scanned at courier handover.

name: Delivery Note-custom_prepare_batch
label: Prepare Batch (labels)
description: The D2C Prepare Batch this DN's label was printed in (label_found=1). Stamped when the batch is created, so a delivery note traces straight to the wave / pick-list / labels PDF it went out on.

name: Delivery Note-custom_dispatched_at
label: Dispatched At
description: Set by the D2C dispatch-scan flow when all of the order's parcels have been scanned at courier handover.

name: Delivery Note-custom_dispatched_by
label: Dispatched By
description: Set by the D2C dispatch-scan flow when all of the order's parcels have been scanned at courier handover.

name: Delivery Note-custom_pack_verified
label: Pack Verified
description: Set when the packer scanned this parcel at the bench, confirmed the piece count and photographed the open box (D2C Pack Verify). Advisory during the pilot — it does not gate dispatch.

name: Delivery Note-custom_pack_verified_at
label: Pack Verified At
description: When the pack verification was recorded. With D2C Dispatch Scan's scanned_at this brackets how long a sealed box waited before courier handover.

name: Sales Order-custom_opd_resolution_id
label: OPD Resolution ID
description: Immutable OPD resolution identifier used for audit traceability and idempotency.

name: Sales Order-custom_opd_auto_fulfill
label: OPD Auto Fulfill Eligible
description: OPD marks only captain-approved, zero-value, original-address replacements. The WMS worker independently validates all evidence before acting.

name: Sales Order-custom_opd_approval_snapshot
label: OPD Approval Snapshot
description: Canonical JSON snapshot of the exact resolution, customer, address, and replacement lines approved in OPD.

name: Sales Order-custom_opd_approval_hash
label: OPD Approval SHA-256
description: SHA-256 of the canonical OPD approval snapshot; rechecked immediately before submission.
